text: Different valid lowerings may have different physical exhaustion points, but changes shall preserve non-resource semantics and mandated accounting, regenerate the execution plan/digests/provenance, and obey ABI/lifetime/association constraints including inlining and tail calls. No portable fixed recursion depth shall be implied.
